extraction.environment: PATH=/tmp/muen-task001-venv/bin:$PATH; no user.yaml, override_layers.yaml, or -D overrides
extraction.sandbox_evidence: Original command had no sandbox option; `bob show --format json -f sandbox arm64-qemu-zcu102-minimal-debug` returned {} for the same configuration.
extraction.ordering_and_identity: Each query line becomes one scm_records entry in original order with a one-based record_number. No URL, package, or directory deduplication is performed.

tag_only_git_observation.reason: No direct source checkout or source audit for this SCM remains. It was reachable only through retained dependency/reference audits from an archive-restored package; no remote tag resolution was substituted.

observed_build_provenance.download_audit_evidence: The final Bob audit and retained package audits provide artifact IDs, build IDs, result hashes, recipes/layers, and dependency/reference chains. Archive-restored package audits can originate from other hosts/Bob versions and are provenance evidence, not direct observations of local source bytes unless an SCM record is present.

limitations: Configured selections and digests describe recipe intent; they do not by themselves prove that every fetched byte was independently rehashed during this correction.
SHA-1-only records are configured integrity selections but use a collision-weaker digest than SHA-256 or SHA-512.
The tag-only Git record has no build-observed commit available from retained direct checkout evidence.
Many dependencies were restored from binary archives. Their audit chains preserve provenance metadata but are not equivalent to local source checkouts.
No bit-for-bit rebuild comparison was performed, and this manifest does not claim a fully verified source closure.
reselection: Install exactly BobBuildTool==1.2.0 in an isolated environment.
Checkout configured_source_selection.top_level.commit and initialize the two pinned submodules.
Run bob layers update and verify all four layer commits.
Ensure no user.yaml, override_layers.yaml, or -D overrides are active; preserve the recorded no-sandbox effective configuration.
Run extraction.query_command and extraction.transformation_command, then compare every ordered SCM record and derived count.
